context: Summary of Haverstone University faculty reimbursement policy as applied to Dorothy Langston's grant-funded travel (Whitfield Foundation, National Genomics Consortium). Filed alongside personal QuickBooks tracking for Schedule C.

validation_rules.notes: Not reimbursable through Whitfield or NGC grants. Personal expense only.
Only one valid receipt per expense.
Require matching bank statement line for verification.

validation_rules.requirement: Reimbursement request submitted more than 60 days after travel
validation_rules.notes: Escalate to Office of Sponsored Research if delayed past 90 days.

validation_rules.requirement: Travel unrelated to Whitfield/NGC grant work
validation_rules.notes: Departmental funding via Haverstone Biological Sciences.
